title: Commons — 40 currencies for renting, meshing, sharing and bartering
status: Design concepts for community-credit systems. Not legal tender, not for sale, no cash value, no redemption, no investment rights.
art: Each currency carries one actual numbered Noun, rendered pixel-for-pixel from the official CC0 Nouns trait data and the verified on-chain seed recorded in public/images/nouns-money/source-100/provenance.json. Forty currencies, forty different Nouns.

themes.name: Rental
themes.summary: Credits for borrowing the expensive, occasional things a town only needs a few of: rooms, rides, gear, machines, time in a room.

themes.name: Mesh
themes.summary: Credits for the people and machines that relay, route and keep a neighborhood connected: radios, wifi, power, ledgers.

themes.name: Sharing
themes.summary: Credits for pooling and splitting: a pie, a tool shelf, a garden, a coffee pot, the chores in a shared house.

themes.name: Barter
themes.summary: Tickets that keep a swap honest when the trade is not simultaneous: jars, fruit, fixes, fish and favors.

currencies.name: Porch Note
currencies.line: A night on a neighbor's spare bed, guest-room-swap style.
currencies.how: Hosts earn a Porch Night for each night they host a visitor and spend one when they travel to another member's town. A night is a night, whatever the house.

currencies.name: Fare Note
currencies.line: Carpool seats among neighbors to the airport, the game or the coast.
currencies.how: Drivers log seats they offer on trips they were already making; riders spend a Seat per trip. Neighbors only, no fares and no commercial rides; any gas money stays separate and voluntary.

currencies.name: Lift Note
currencies.line: Skis, boards and wetsuits from a shared gear shed, by the day.
currencies.how: The shed lends kit by the day. Return it clean and on time and you earn a Gear Day back; donate a set and you start with a season's worth.

currencies.name: Spin Cycle
currencies.line: A load in the building's shared laundry room.
currencies.how: Residents prepay the laundry room's running costs and receive Loads. Fixing a machine or folding the lost-and-found earns Loads back.

currencies.name: Camera Desk
currencies.line: Cameras, mics and lights from a shared AV shelf.
currencies.how: Members check out a kit for a Shoot Day. Teaching a lighting class or lending your own gear to the shelf earns Shoot Days.

currencies.name: Island Week
currencies.line: A week's home swap with another family.
currencies.how: Families list the weeks their home is free. Host a week, earn a Week; spend it on any other listed home, beach shack or city flat alike.

currencies.name: Screening Room
currencies.line: The back-room projector, booked for a neighborhood movie night.
currencies.how: One Reel books the room for an evening. Hosting a free public screening earns two back; cleaning up after earns one.

currencies.name: Desk Day
currencies.line: A day at a shared worktable with wifi and a coffee pot.
currencies.how: Members spend a Desk Day per visit. Opening up in the morning, closing at night or mentoring a student earns Desk Days.

currencies.name: Game Library
currencies.line: A console or board game borrowed for the weekend.
currencies.how: Borrow a game for a Weekend. Donate a game and you earn three; bring it back late and it costs one more.

currencies.name: Commissary
currencies.line: An hour in a shared kitchen for bakers and pop-ups.
currencies.how: Bakers book the kitchen by the hour. Deep-cleaning, receiving deliveries or training a newcomer earns Kitchen Hours.

currencies.name: Microgrid
currencies.line: A tally of who lent solar and battery to the block.
currencies.how: A block keeps a shared tally of surplus rooftop solar and battery it lends to neighbors in an outage. Any real energy sharing would run through the utility's interconnection rules; this is the scoreboard, not the wire.

currencies.name: Signal
currencies.line: Relay a message across a neighborhood radio mesh.
currencies.how: Every node that relays a neighbor's message earns a Hop; nodes spend Hops to send a town-wide broadcast. The more you carry, the more you can say.

currencies.name: Router
currencies.line: Credit for the node that finds the way through.
currencies.how: When traffic crosses the mesh, each router on the path earns a Route. Members spend Routes to request a new rooftop link.

currencies.name: Tentacle Net
currencies.line: Share a strand of your connection with the block.
currencies.how: Members who open a guest strand of community wifi earn Strands for the hours it stays up; visitors spend Strands to get online.

currencies.name: Moonbounce
currencies.line: A radio-club relay credit. Bounce it off the moon.
currencies.how: Club stations earn an Echo for each relayed contact logged during a drill. Echoes book the club's big antenna for an evening.

currencies.name: Planet Node
currencies.line: Credit for adding your rooftop to the shared map.
currencies.how: Install a node, confirm it on the map and earn a Node. Nodes vote on where the next relay goes.

currencies.name: Ledger Node
currencies.line: Credit for checking the shared books.
currencies.how: Volunteers earn Entries for verifying other members' logged trades. Two independent checks close a line; disputes go to a human table, not a script.

currencies.name: Bars
currencies.line: Credit for carrying signal into a dead zone.
currencies.how: Measure coverage before and after you add a repeater. Each bar of improvement on the shared map earns a Bar.

currencies.name: Ring Network
currencies.line: A ring of local shops passing each other customers.
currencies.how: Shops hand a Ring to a customer they send next door. The receiving shop stamps it, and every quarter the ring publishes who sent whom.

currencies.name: Ink Relay
currencies.line: A zine passed hand to hand; each reader adds a page.
currencies.how: Add a page and earn an Ink. Spend an Ink to start a new issue's chain, or to print one copy at the shop.

currencies.name: Slice
currencies.line: Split the pie at block parties.
currencies.how: Whoever brings the pie hands out Slices. Bring a pie next time, or a salad or a speaker, and the Slices come back around.

currencies.name: Fair Wedge
currencies.line: One fair wedge of whatever the group bought together.
currencies.how: A buying club splits bulk orders into Wedges so the person who fronted the cash gets made whole in goods, not interest.

currencies.name: Cookie Jar
currencies.line: The bake-sale jar for the school garden.
currencies.how: Bakers earn Cookies for each dozen donated; shoppers trade Cookies for treats at the table. Every bake sale ends with the jar counted out loud.

currencies.name: Long Table
currencies.line: Cook once, feed twelve.
currencies.how: Community-dinner cooks earn a Bowl for every plate served. Dishwashers earn them too. Bowls get you a seat at any table.

currencies.name: Little Library
currencies.line: Take a book, leave a book.
currencies.how: Leave a book in a sidewalk library and earn a Chapter. Chapters reserve the next copy of a popular title.

currencies.name: Tool Library
currencies.line: Borrow the big tool instead of buying one.
currencies.how: Members borrow ladders, saws and tile cutters by the day. Sharpening blades, fixing cords and teaching safety classes earn Tool Days.

currencies.name: Coffee Pot
currencies.line: The office coffee kitty, made visible.
currencies.how: Buy a bag of beans for the shared pot and earn Cups. Brewing the first pot earns a few more. Nobody has to wonder who chipped in.

currencies.name: Court Time
currencies.line: Share the beach court and the net.
currencies.how: Setting up the net or raking the sand earns Games. Games hold the court for a match at peak hours.

currencies.name: Garden Plot
currencies.line: Community garden plots and the harvest share.
currencies.how: Weeding, watering shifts and compost turns earn Rows. Rows claim a share of the communal beds at harvest.

currencies.name: Dish Duty
currencies.line: The chores in a shared house, kept fair.
currencies.how: Each chore is worth Shifts. Do more than your share and bank them for exam week or a long trip.

currencies.name: Taco Trade
currencies.line: Trade a skill for lunch.
currencies.how: A taco truck takes Tacos from neighbors who fix its sign, paint its menu or run the line on a busy night, and hands them out for lunch.

currencies.name: Garlic Braid
currencies.line: Farmers-market swaps between stalls.
currencies.how: Stallholders trade produce with each other in Braids during the market and settle up at closing with whatever is left.

currencies.name: Bean Barter
currencies.line: Coffee for fixes: barista to bike mechanic.
currencies.how: The cafe pays the bike shop in Beans for a flat fixed; the mechanic spends them on espresso. A favor economy with a receipt.

currencies.name: Shell
currencies.line: The oldest money idea, at a beach trade-in day.
currencies.how: Bring beach-cleanup trash to the table and earn Shells; trade Shells for secondhand wetsuits, boards and books at the swap.

currencies.name: Pickle Swap
currencies.line: A canning swap, jar for jar.
currencies.how: Bring a jar, take a ticket, pick a jar. Tickets let you trade across the season, so June strawberries can become October salsa.

currencies.name: Pineapple Swap
currencies.line: Backyard fruit exchange: lemons for avocados.
currencies.how: Neighbors with a heavy tree drop off a crate and receive a Crate ticket to spend when a different tree is in season.

currencies.name: Berry Pick
currencies.line: Pick-your-own harvest trades.
currencies.how: Pickers earn Pints for a morning's work at a member farm and spend them on any member farm's produce later in the year.

currencies.name: Swap Counter
currencies.line: Bring an item, get a ticket.
currencies.how: A swap-meet counter values each donated item in Tickets and hangs it on the rack. Tickets take anything else off the rack.

currencies.name: Cobbler
currencies.line: A repair cafe: a fix for a fix.
currencies.how: Fix a neighbor's toaster, boot or bike and earn a Fix. Spend it on a fix you cannot do yourself.

currencies.name: Catch of the Day
currencies.line: Fishing-club trades at the dock.
currencies.how: Members log their share of a club trip's catch in Catches and trade them for bait, boat time or another member's smoked fish.
